nu = pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
exe = str(pathlib.Path('executable.cmd').resolve())

 ['--version'], ['-c','1 + 2'], ['-c','\"hello\"'], ['-c','[1 2 3]'], ['-c','{a: 1, b: \"x\"}'],

 ['-c','1 < 2'], ['-c','true and false'], ['-c','not false'], ['-c','[1 2 3] | length'], ['-c','[1 2 3] | math sum'], ['-c','[1 2 3] | math avg'],

 ['-c','[[a b]; [1 x] [2 y]] | to json'], ['-c','[[a b]; [1 x] [2 y]] | to csv'],
 ['-c','[[name age]; [ann 3] [bob 4]] | get name'], ['-c','[[name age]; [ann 3] [bob 4]] | where age > 3 | get name.0'],
 ['-c','{a: {b: 2}} | get a.b'], ['-c','[10 20 30].1'], ['-c','{a: 1}.a'], ['-c','1..3 | math sum'], ['-c','seq 1 3'], ['--no-newline','-c','1 + 2'],
]
for args in cases:
    r = subprocess.run([nu]+args, capture_output=True)
    p = subprocess.run([exe]+args, capture_output=True)
    if (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr) "'!= (p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr):
        print('"'DIFF', args)
        print('ref', r.returncode, repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')), repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:200]))
        print('py ', p.returncode, repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')), repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:200]))
'@ | python -"
